utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — if you could share the repair drive details with nearby neighbors, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll pass it along. Saturday morning at the community center, and the fence and porch light are still the top priorities.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — that’s really helpful. I appreciate you passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’m checking the supplies now and I’ll send you the updated list soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just checking, you’re still on it for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m still on it, and I’ll send the updated supplies list soon with anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any tools and a short list of supplies you can gather? I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll slot you into the tasks from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a few tools and a short list of supplies I can gather for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping it simple: I’ll have the repair list ready by 9, and we’ll stick to the basic fixes. If you need anything else, check back then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ll check back at 9 and confirm the list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — I’ll have everything ready by 9 and keep it to the basic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll set up the tables by the hall entrance and keep an eye on the supply boxes. Send the details over, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—I’ll send the details over now and keep you posted on the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll be ready to help and keep an eye on everything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still checking the details — I’ll send you the list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out for the list. I’m still ready to help with the porch step and the faucet at Mrs. Alvarez’s place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll send the list over as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I still haven’t heard a firm schedule, but Hana’s organizing it. I’ll probably be late and just check in when I arrive to help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’m already out running errands, so I’ll swing by and check on the latest repair drive details, then let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. I’ll check in when I get there and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s organizing the repair drive, and when should we expect the details?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m organizing it, and I’ll send the time and place soon. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for the time and place. Let me know if you need any help with the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — if you hear of any extra boxes, labels, or packing tape, please let me know. I’m trying to make sure the sorting doesn’t get chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any extra boxes, labels, or packing tape I find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — that really helps. I’ll keep the sorting plan simple, and if anything else comes up, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together—have you heard who’s organizing it and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t nailed down the organizer or exact start time yet, but I’m still asking around and I’ll tell you as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an ear out too. Let me know if you hear whether Hana’s coordinating it and what time they settle on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help—just let me know what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I’m waiting on the repair list to be confirmed, then I can work around school drop-off and pickup. Once I have the timing, I’ll coordinate my schedule and help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — just send me the confirmed list when it’s ready, and I’ll help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, got it — tools, tape, screws, and a couple extension cords by 9. I’ll see what I can round up too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll bring my tools over and we’ll be set by 9.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring what I can by 9 and keep an eye out for anything else we might need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list organized. Send me any supplies or volunteer names when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m likely to be late, but I’ll check in when I arrive and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — just check in when you get there, and I’ll have something ready for you to jump into.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’m still good to help. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring any tools you’ve got and help sort the broken stuff Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring what I have and help sort Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I can bring the tools over for the repair drive. Just send me the time when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the start time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know when it’s set, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I’ll swing by and check the repair drive details, then let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll keep it simple here and have the details ready by 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll stop by and check the details, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m still good to help — just let me know what time the repair drive is happening, and I’ll work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — I’ll confirm the time and send it over. Thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check what we’re still short on and send you the updated supplies list plus a few volunteer names soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot — I’m mostly worried we’ll run short on boxes, labels, or packing tape again. Once you send the list, I can keep an eye out for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check those first and flag any gaps on the list. If I spot anything else we’re missing, I’ll send it right over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That really helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help—I'll make sure the nearby neighbors get the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I really appreciate you doing that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to the neighbors nearby and send the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that’s a big help. If you can, send me the list of neighbors who still need assistance and their addresses so I can coordinate the next stops.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll gather the neighbors who still need help and send you their addresses right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules — can you send me the details by 9? I still need the organizer and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the organizer info and repair list by 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll watch for it by 9.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help — just send over the details, and I can sort supplies or set up tables.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Mara — I’ll pass your help along and ask around for the coordinator and timing too. I’ll come right back with whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just send the coordinator and timing when you have them, and I’ll take care of supplies or tables.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring the tools by 9 and start with the porch step. What else still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s still tools, tape, screws, and a couple extension cords — and if we’ve got any other broken stuff, bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring tools, tape, screws, and extension cords by 9. If I spot anything else broken, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the repair list first, then we can divide up what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that makes sense — I’m a little scattered, but I remember the loose porch step and Mrs. Alvarez’s leaky faucet are still on the list. If you want, I can help confirm the rest and then we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — let’s confirm those two and see what’s still missing before we split anything up.
